snippet.title: Fleet Hunters - Demo Out Now on Steam | Wishlist Now
snippet.description:
Find and sink battleships in a fast grid-based ocean duel with real-time firing, retro visuals, and destructible ships.

Place your fleet, track the enemy, and fire as soon as your weapons are ready. No waiting for turns as both players act at the same time in a tense back-and-forth duel where every hit, miss, and clue matters.

The Fleet Hunters demo is out now on Steam.

Wishlist Fleet Hunters on Steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4074510/Fleet_Hunters/

Fleet Hunters is coming to PC, Mac, and Linux.
